_derived_comment: The chain that actually ships. Dockerfile.derived builds FROM a previous release's digest, so this generation's depth is that release's measured depth plus its own filesystem instructions -- a fact no source file states, which is why it is declared here and keyed to the digest it was measured from. base_layers is `docker image inspect <repo>@<base_digest> --format '{{len .RootFS.Layers}}'`; pull_limit is the 125-layer ceiling of Docker's pull graph, the same one check_image_depth.py defaults to. Move base_digest and this count moves with it or the gate refuses.
